title: LUMI 超級電腦架構
subcategoryTitle: 高效能運算與世界級超算
summary: 以LUMI 的 CPU/GPU 分割槽與高頻寬計算串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect lumi cpu/gpu partitions and high-bandwidth computing with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 任務與分割槽
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「任務與分割槽」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop tasks and partitions through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 分割槽目的：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「分割槽目的」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for partition purposes.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「分割槽目的」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：LUMI-C 與 LUMI-G 對應不同處理資源。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for partition purposes. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: LUMI-C and LUMI-G serve different processing resources. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有分割槽都必須用 GPU。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every partition requires GPUs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「分割槽目的」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for partition purposes; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: LUMI-C 與 LUMI-G 對應不同處理資源。
knowledge.textEn: LUMI-C and LUMI-G serve different processing resources.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 4096³ 個 FP64 格點單陣列為 549755813888 bytes，即 512 GiB；若每邏輯 GPU 假想能分配 50 GiB，至少需 ceil(512/50)=11 個裝置，只算單陣列。halo、第二緩衝與庫工作空間將提高需求，不能當實際 LUMI 配額。
knowledge.textEn: A synthetic 4096-cubed FP64 array is 512 GiB. At assumed usable 50 GiB/logical GPU it needs at least 11 devices for one array only. Halos, extra buffers and library workspaces add capacity; this is not a LUMI quota.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「LUMI 超級電腦架構」的「分割槽目的：原理與架構」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Partition purposes: principles and architecture” in “LUMI supercomputer architecture”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「分割槽目的」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for partition purposes?
options: 所有分割槽都必須用 GPU。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「分割槽目的」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
LUMI-C 與 LUMI-G 對應不同處理資源。
optionsEn: Every partition requires GPUs.
One matching output proves partition purposes for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
LUMI-C and LUMI-G serve different processing resources.
quiz.explanation: LUMI-C 與 LUMI-G 對應不同處理資源。 按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。 因此「所有分割槽都必須用 GPU。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: LUMI-C and LUMI-G serve different processing resources. Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. The alternative "Every partition requires GPUs." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 分割槽目的：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「分割槽目的」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for partition purposes.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。」；將結果與「LUMI-C 與 LUMI-G 對應不同處理資源。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. Compare results against: LUMI-C and LUMI-G serve different processing resources. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 按玩具任務分出 CPU-only 與 GPU 部分。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Split toy tasks into CPU-only and GPU parts. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有分割槽都必須用 GPU。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every partition requires GPUs. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「分割槽目的」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「所有分割槽都必須用 GPU。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for partition purposes; explain why this claim fails: Every partition requires GPUs.

knowledge.textEn: Mark toy package-to-logical-GPU mappings. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

quiz.question: 審查「GPU 節點」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for gpu nodes?
options: MI250X 封裝與 GCD 數需區分。
GPU 封裝數永遠等於邏輯裝置數。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「GPU 節點」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: MI250X packages and GCD counts are distinguished.
GPU package and logical-device counts always agree.
One matching output proves gpu nodes for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: MI250X 封裝與 GCD 數需區分。 標示玩具封裝與邏輯 GPU 對應。 因此「GPU 封裝數永遠等於邏輯裝置數。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: MI250X packages and GCD counts are distinguished. Mark toy package-to-logical-GPU mappings. The alternative "GPU package and logical-device counts always agree." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: GPU 節點：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「GPU 節點」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for gpu nodes.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「標示玩具封裝與邏輯 GPU 對應。」；將結果與「MI250X 封裝與 GCD 數需區分。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Mark toy package-to-logical-GPU mappings. Compare results against: MI250X packages and GCD counts are distinguished. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 標示玩具封裝與邏輯 GPU 對應。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Mark toy package-to-logical-GPU mappings. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：GPU 封裝數永遠等於邏輯裝置數。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: GPU package and logical-device counts always agree. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「GPU 節點」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「GPU 封裝數永遠等於邏輯裝置數。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for gpu nodes; explain why this claim fails: GPU package and logical-device counts always agree.

steps.title: 記憶體層次：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「記憶體層次」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for memory hierarchy.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「記憶體層次」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：主機記憶體與加速器 HBM 位置不同。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具陣列的分配與移轉。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for memory hierarchy. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Host memory and accelerator HBM have different locations. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Draw allocation and transfer of toy arrays. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫玩具陣列的分配與移轉。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Draw allocation and transfer of toy arrays. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：所有記憶體都視為同一延遲空間。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: All memory has one latency space. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「記憶體層次」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫玩具陣列的分配與移轉。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for memory hierarchy; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
